data.goal: Replace the singleton-based, header-only, leak-prone JobSystem with a value-typed instance owned by JobSystemModule that exposes a three-primitive RAII handle API (Submit / Wait / IsComplete).
data.current_problem: Singleton + header-only impl + manual Job* lifetime causes child-job leaks, double-Run hazards, undocumented lifetime contract, and dead surface (priority, work-stealing, ParallelFor) that no production caller uses.

target_shape.ownership: JobSystemModule holds a Dia::Core::JobSystem by value. Callers receive Dia::Core::JobSystem* via service locator (or are passed a reference). No Meyers singleton.
api: JobHandle JobSystem::Submit(JobFn fn)  — refcounted handle; Job is freed when last handle drops AND job has finished
void JobSystem::Wait(const JobHandle& h) — blocks until fn() has fully executed; safe to call from any thread including a worker
bool JobSystem::IsComplete(const JobHandle& h) — non-blocking check; safe after Wait
void JobSystem::Initialize(unsigned numThreads) / Shutdown() — called by JobSystemModule only
target_shape.handle_semantics: JobHandle is a small value type wrapping shared_ptr<Job> (or equivalent intrusive refcount). Copying the handle increases refcount. Holding it past Wait is safe and a no-op on re-Wait.
target_shape.thread_pool: ThreadPool gets impl moved to .cpp. Shutdown semantic chosen: drain (run remaining tasks) before joining; document this. Workers exit on shutdown only when queue empty AND flag set.
target_shape.header_layout: JobSystem.h declares JobSystem, JobHandle, JobFn. JobSystem.cpp holds impl. ThreadPool.h gets a slim public surface; ThreadPool.cpp holds workers.
target_shape.diagnostics: DIA_ASSERT on Submit-after-Shutdown. DIA_ASSERT on double-Initialize. Wait on a never-Run handle is impossible because Submit always Runs.

boundary_changes: JobSystem moves from globally-accessible singleton to instance reachable through JobSystemModule (service locator or accessor).
ParallelFor helper removed from JobSystem.h (deferred until needed).
ThreadPool implementation moves from .h to .cpp; public surface unchanged.

responsibilities_before_after.before: Manual: caller calls Wait which deletes; child jobs leak
responsibilities_before_after.after: Refcounted JobHandle; Job released when handle count == 0 AND job finished
Removed; reintroduced via separate spec when a real caller appears

affected_systems.name: JobSystemModule (Cluiche/CluicheGameBaseline)
affected_systems.change: Holds JobSystem instance. Registers it with service locator on DoStart; deregisters on DoStop.

affected_systems.name: TextureHandler (Dia/DiaSFML)
affected_systems.change: Receives JobSystem* (constructor or setter). Replaces JobSystem::CreateJob/Run/Wait calls with instance->Submit / Wait. Drops shared_ptr<PendingUpload> if handle keeps state alive — TBD during execute, may stay as-is for migration safety.

affected_systems.name: AsyncFileLoader (Dia/DiaCore/FilePath)
affected_systems.change: Currently uses ThreadPool directly, not JobSystem — no API change needed for the JobSystem refactor. ThreadPool .cpp split will recompile this TU but not change semantics.

affected_systems.name: GoogleTests (Cluiche/Tests/GoogleTests/Core/Threading)
affected_systems.change: TestJobSystem.cpp loses parent/child + ParallelFor cases (deferred). Adds tests for the audit's missing-test list. Tests construct a local JobSystem instance instead of using a singleton.

api_changes.before: static JobSystem& GetInstance(); static Job* CreateJob(JobFn); static void Run(Job*); static void Wait(Job*); static bool IsComplete(Job*); ParallelFor template
api_changes.after: class JobSystem { void Initialize(unsigned); void Shutdown(); JobHandle Submit(JobFn); void Wait(const JobHandle&); bool IsComplete(const JobHandle&); }; struct JobHandle { ... };

api_changes.before: Full impl in header (constructor, Enqueue, WaitAll, Shutdown, WorkerThread)
api_changes.after: Class declaration only; impl moves to ThreadPool.cpp

migration_phases.name: Carve out JobSystem.cpp + JobHandle skeleton
migration_phases.description: Move ThreadPool impl to ThreadPool.cpp (no API change). Introduce JobSystem.cpp with the new instance-shaped class behind a feature toggle: keep old static API delegating to a hidden global instance so callers don't break. Add JobHandle type. Add new tests for missing-test list against the new API. CHECKPOINT: builds + all tests pass.

migration_phases.name: Migrate JobSystemModule to instance ownership
migration_phases.description: JobSystemModule holds a JobSystem by value (or unique_ptr). Service-locator-registers a JobSystem* on DoStart, removes on DoStop. Spec update: jobsystem-module.md architecture section reflects instance ownership. CHECKPOINT: cluichetest launches; module logs init/shutdown.
migration_phases.risk: Medium — touches live ApplicationFlow module. Requires the service-locator hookup to exist or be added. Validate by running cluichetest end-to-end.

migration_phases.name: Migrate TextureHandler to instance API
migration_phases.description: TextureHandler receives JobSystem* via constructor or AssetService wiring. Replace JobSystem::Create/Run/Wait calls with instance->Submit/Wait. Verify shutdown-drain semantics (the dtor's wait loop must still work). CHECKPOINT: dummystage texture loads still work; teardown clean.
migration_phases.risk: Medium — last production caller of the JobSystem API. Lifetime nuance with PendingUpload.

migration_phases.name: Remove the static-API shim and dead surface
migration_phases.description: Delete the static singleton bridge added in Phase 1. Delete ParallelFor, parent-child API (Job::parent, CreateChildJob, Finish-walking-parent), priority field, work-stealing comments. Update GoogleTests to drop parent/child + ParallelFor tests (file an issue or deferred-feature note). Strip stale doc strings.
migration_phases.risk: Low — only removes deprecated surface once callers are off it.

migration_phases.name: Tighten ThreadPool shutdown + add diagnostics
migration_phases.description: Document and assert: ThreadPool drains queue on Shutdown. Submit after Shutdown asserts. Double-Initialize asserts. Add tests for these.

data.minimal_viable_slice: Phase 1 alone delivers value: ThreadPool impl is split, JobHandle exists, missing-test cases land. The static-API shim keeps existing callers working, so even if Phases 2-5 stall the bug-fixes (drain semantics, leak fix via handle) are reachable.

risks_and_rollback.risk: Service locator wiring for JobSystem* doesn't exist in current AppFlow — Phase 2 may need to add it.
risks_and_rollback.mitigation: During Phase 2, check for an existing service registry in DiaApplicationFlow. If absent, fall back to a plain accessor on JobSystemModule and pass via constructor wiring in module factories.
risks_and_rollback.rollback: Revert Phase 2 commit; the static-shim keeps the old code working.

risks_and_rollback.risk: TextureHandler's PendingUpload shared_ptr was added to outlive the Job. JobHandle changes that — keeping the lambda alive via handle could be enough.
risks_and_rollback.mitigation: During Phase 3, decide: keep shared_ptr (zero-risk) or simplify (touch lifetime — needs verification). Default = keep.
risks_and_rollback.rollback: Revert TextureHandler commit; module wiring continues to work because Phase 2 didn't touch TextureHandler.

risks_and_rollback.risk: Dropping ParallelFor breaks a test that other tests indirectly rely on for setup.
risks_and_rollback.mitigation: Phase 4 audits TestJobSystem.cpp for transitive uses before deleting.
risks_and_rollback.rollback: Restore from prior commit; ParallelFor can survive in a deprecated namespace if needed.

risks_and_rollback.risk: Phase 5's drain semantics could change observable shutdown timing for existing callers.
risks_and_rollback.mitigation: Drain is the de-facto behaviour callers expect today (they Wait first); changing the contract from 'undefined' to 'drain' should not break any caller that wasn't already broken.

acceptance_criteria: AC1 — All callers (JobSystemModule, TextureHandler) use the instance-based JobSystem; no caller calls JobSystem static methods.
AC2 — Job allocations have no leaks: every Submit returns a JobHandle, and the Job is freed when refcount hits zero AND the job has finished.
AC3 — Calling Wait from inside a running job does not deadlock under any existing test or new test.
AC4 — Submit after Shutdown asserts (test verifies).
AC5 — Header docstrings describe only implemented features; no work-stealing or priority claims.
AC6 — JobSystem.h and ThreadPool.h have only declarations (impl in .cpp).
AC7 — Existing TextureHandler behaviour (cluichetest dummy stage texture load + teardown) is preserved.
AC8 — GoogleTest suite for Threading still passes; new tests cover the missing-test list.
